source.quote: Cash paid for income tax 1,013 1,052 651 Non-cash financing activities: Finance [USD millions; FY2025 is the 1st figure in the row]

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: 'Cash paid for income tax' in the supplemental cash-flow information (tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet); the caption does not say whether refunds are netted. R&D not reported as a separate line. MercadoLibre reports 'Product and technology development' ($2,269 million in 2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K describes as salaries, technology maintenance and other costs without calling it research and development, so it is not recorded.
